mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% and has risen by more than 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) signals an overheating economy and aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen and UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above the 3-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS is above its 3-month moving average during a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has risen over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200,000 units indicates a weakening housing sector, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1,200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high year-over-year inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) indicates inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above the 3-month moving average indicates strong labor demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 3-month moving average during a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%).
